messages.content: What are Bonnie Blake's contact details and profile-listed courses?

progress.draft:
Bonnie Blake is listed as Professor, Graphic Design & Interactive Media. Contact details: email bblake@ramapo.edu, phone (201) 684-7597, office A-207, School of Arts, Humanities, and Education.

Her profile-listed courses are COMM 219 Idea Development; COMM 310 Apocalyptic Visions in Anime, Film & Media; COMM 327 Motion Graphics & Title Design; COMM 339 Publication Design; COMM 360 Good & Evil in Design Film & Visual Media; COMM 362 Interactive Animation Design; COMM 404 Senior Project: Visual Communication Design; and COMM 405 Visual Identity Design.

The course list comes from an undated faculty profile, so it does not show current-semester teaching assignments, sections, or availability.
